Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Integrate live APIs, placeholder indicators, .env config, and Docker

- Connect 6 free data sources: Binance Futures \(funding/OI\), Binance daily
  \(CME proxy\), DefiLlama stablecoins, FRED API \(CPI/NFP/ISM PMI via
  FRED_API_KEY\), static FOMC 2025-2026 calendar; FedWatch stays placeholder
- Add is_placeholder flag to every data source return dict
- Add placeholder_sources list to ReportContext; indicators/compute.py
  collects names of fallback sources automatically
- Add data source status panel to frontend \(Live/假資料 badges per source\)
- Add ⚠️ badges on KPI values backed by placeholder data
- Add .env management: python-dotenv auto-loads .env, fred_api_key in
  Settings, .env.example documents all env vars
- Add Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml \(SQLite persisted via volume\), .dockerignore
- Add CLAUDE.md with commands, architecture, and data source status table
- 9-phase refactoring: logging, thread safety, input validation, deduplication,
  configurable thresholds \(signals/config.py\), type safety, decomposed refresh,
  27-test suite, docstrings

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Redesign frontend with Tailwind CSS dark theme and fix AI button bug

- Replace custom CSS with Tailwind CDN: dark slate-950 theme, responsive
  grid layout, color-coded signal metrics \(emerald/rose\), purple AI panel
- Fix AI bug: split AI section into separate idle/output divs so analysis
  never appears before button click; resetAiSection\(\) on language change;
  setI18nText\(\) skips #ai-advice to prevent accidental overwrites
- Slim styles.css to 51 lines \(fade-in animation + dark scrollbar only\)
- Migrate AI backend from OpenAI to Gemini API \(gemini-3.5-pro\)
- Fix FRED CSV column detection \(observation_date vs DATE\)
- Add Binance exchangeInfo validation to filter invalid trading pairs
- Revert ISM PMI to clean placeholder \(NAPM discontinued from FRED\)
- Add /report/weekly/ai endpoint for on-demand AI analysis only

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
